_source: Select Group project page for West Avenue, read 17 September 2026 (manifest: data/media/_sources/west_avenue.json).
_assets_from: 16 images published openly. Brochure and floor plans sit behind an enquiry form and were NOT fetched.
_override_note: Every image was identified from a scout's record of what it ACTUALLY SHOWS, after opening it. Select mislabels rooms here more than on any other building: the files named '05-West-Avenue-Bedroom', '12-West-Avenue-Bedroom' and '13-West-Avenue-Bedroom' are all living spaces, and none is used as the bedroom. Two different images share the prefix 15720_Apartments - one is the tower, one is the gym - so the hero is pinned by its full asset id, not by name.
image_note: Images are published by Select Group, the developer of West Avenue, on its own project page, and are reproduced here for a buyer considering the building. The exterior is a photograph of the completed tower; the interiors show show apartments and common areas, and the finish of an individual unit may differ. Ask to view before relying on them.
caveats: Select Group publishes no apartment layouts openly for this building — its floor plans sit behind an enquiry form, which we do not fill in. Ask and we will request the plan for a specific unit.
